name: Güéjar Sierra (Spain)
description: White field with a light blue triangle along the upper hoist and a greyish-green triangle along the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Güéjar Sierra (a mountain, a bridge and a deer on blue, inscribed GÜÉJAR SIERRA).
history: Municipal flag of Güéjar Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle along the upper edge from the hoist
triangle along the lower edge at the fly
Güéjar Sierra arms — mountain, bridge and deer, inscribed
